glosses: stone, pit (the central part of some fruits, consisting of the seed and a hard endocarp layer (like those of peach, olive, avocado or mango))

examples.text: ¿Alguna vez te has roto un hueso?
examples.en: Have you ever broken a bone?

examples.text: A menudo, los perros entierran huesos.
Tom le dio un hueso a su perro.
examples.en: Tom gave his dog a bone.

examples.text: Se rompió uno de los huesos de su pierna.
examples.en: He broke one of the bones in his leg.
She is all skin and bone.
